It passes LarpCheck, and I see more reasons for upside than downside at these levels, so I’ll keep accumulating on dips. Any acknowledgment from Pokémon itself would just be an insane bonus.

What’s also interesting is that every paid check contributes to buying back and burning $WORM, tying actual product usage directly to the token.

Pair that with doxxed devs, a registered company and an audit by Zauth, and there’s quite a bit to like here.

Everyone’s focused on what AI agents can do, but not enough people are thinking about what happens when they do something they shouldn’t.

That’s a narrative worth paying attention to imo. 🪱
